# Music and sound-effect models

What each music and sound-effect model takes besides the prompt. Put setting values in `settings`; `references/audio.md` explains each kind of setting.

| Model | Kind | Settings |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Eleven Music v2.5 | music | `duration` (15, 30, 60, 120, 180; default 30); `force_instrumental` (true or false; default true) |
| Lyria 3.5 | music | - |
| Eleven Sound Effects | sound effect | `duration` (1, 2, 3, 5, 10, 20, 30; default 3); `loop` (true or false; default false); `prompt_influence` (0 to 1; default 0.3) |
| Mirelo SFX 2.0 | sound effect | `duration` (1, 2, 3, 5, 10, 20, 30, 60; default 5); `negative_prompt` (text) |
